New features include:

  • You can now login to your Voat user account (multiple accounts is not tested since I can't seem to create a new one)
  • Subscriptions for your user are fetched
  • Added the ability to subscribe/unsubscribe from subverses
  • Generally smoother scrolling
  • Thumbnails are now highlighted if they can be previewed using the long press gesture
  • After previewing an image, if you let go of the image while it is larger than half the screen size, it will expand into a full screen zoomable image view
  • Added the ability to go to a Random Subverse
  • User details screen is now a native screen
  • Added the ability to view a subverse's sidebar
  • Added search/sort for a Subverse's submissions
  • You can now automatically fetch more of a Subverse's submissions by scrolling to the bottom
  • Added the ability to browse All Subverses
  • Added the ability to go to a submission's user or subverse from the Comments screen
  • Added the ability to go to a submission's user, subverse, or comments from the Web browser
  • The app will now try to go to a native screen if it detects a supported Voat link
  • Comments with a score less than -2 are now hidden by default
  • You can now browse a user's submitted posts and comments
  • Fixed markdown parsing bug that caused broken links
  • Added /user/ supported prefix
  • Added the ability to "View on Voat" which will open a web browser to the Voat page that you are viewing
  • Added collapsing section headers on Home screen
